title: A psicanálise é uma ciência ou uma pseudociência? Is psychoanalysis a science or a pseudoscience? ¿Es el psicoanálisis una ciencia o una pseudociencia?
abstract: A resenha analisa o livro "Ciência pouca é bobagem", de Dunker e Ianini, que defende a psicanálise contra a acusação de pseudociência. A obra argumenta que o verdadeiro adversário é o cientificismo, e não a ciência, propondo que a psicanálise possui um rigor interno e método próprios, embora distintos das ciências naturais. A resenha elogia essa defesa, mas aponta como falha o fato de o livro não responder a críticas contemporâneas importantes. No geral, o texto resenhado é avaliado como uma contribuição relevante ao debate, ainda que deixe lacunas críticas em aberto.

title: Em torno de uma zooliteratura para crianças On a zooliterature for children Alrededor de una zooliteratura para niños
abstract: This paper examines the relationship between literature, childhood, and animality, emphasizing the role of animal protagonists in children's literature in Brazil. The primary objective is to present a collection of books intended for children, written by five notable Brazilian authors known for their works for adults: Jorge Amado, Carlos Drummond de Andrade, Ignácio de Loyola Brandão, Chico Buarque, and Clarice Lispector. The intention is to contextualize animality as a central element in the experiences and narratives of the selected texts. The findings indicate the creation of a poetic and argumentative space where a potential animality emerges not merely as a counterpart to subjectivity, but as an opportunity to affirm an ethical-aesthetic framework characterized by the blending of boundaries between human and animal existence.

title: A psicoesfera na era viral The psychosphere in the viral age La psicosfera en la era viral
abstract: The article is an interview with Italian thinker Franco Berardi “Bifo”, based on his latest book published in Brazil, The Third Unconscious: the Psychosphere in the Viral Age (2024). In dialogue with other productions and with his long intellectual and political career, the conversation addresses the relationship between the expansion of digital technologies, the informational regime of contemporary capitalism and new forms of control and subjectivation. This relationship, intensified by the acceleration of the infosphere, acts in phenomena of profound psychic mutation, observed in new psychopathologies of the semiocapitalism. The second field of reflection has to do with the very nature of political action in the present. Bifo makes interesting provocations about the exhaustion of the political form as an instrument for transforming reality, suggesting ways of creating and sustaining social and sensible bifurcations.

title: O ensino superior brasileiro em perspectiva Brazilian higher education in perspective La educación superior brasileña en perspectiva
abstract: Trata-se de uma resenha crítica do livro “Escritos sobre educação superior no Brasil: transformações nas três últimas décadas”.

title: Método de cocuradoria cartográfica-conectiva para a produção do conhecimento - 2CpC Cartographic-connective co-curation method for knowledge production - 2CpC Método de cocuraduría cartográfica-connectiva para la producción del conocimiento – 2CpC
abstract: The word "curadoria," derived from the Latin curator and curare (to care for and watch over), is traditionally associated with the arts and museums. However, curation has been expanding into various fields, including digital and academic contexts. In this scenario, co-curation emerges as a collaborative and connective practice between human and non-human entities, such as digital technologies, thereby broadening the diversity of perspectives. The Connective Cartographic Co-Curation Method for Knowledge Production (2CpC) arises from the intersection of the OnLIFE Education Paradigm and the Cartographic Method of Reticular, Ecological, and Connective Research-Intervention (rECOnectivo). In this context, the article aims to present the development of the 2CpC Co-Curation Method, highlighting its potential, and to analyze the process of its application in the seminar "Introduction to Educational Theories," conducted within a Graduate Program in Education at a university in southern Brazil. The methodological approach of 2CpC Co-Curation included problematization, co-creation of research axes, knowledge sharing, and critical reviews. title: A reforma do ensino médio High school reform Reforma de la enseñanza secundária
abstract: The article is the product of research carried out in 2021 and 2022, which sought to map the conditions for implementing Law 13415/2017. The methodological procedures consisted of: a) an exploratory analysis of the websites of the state education departments and other official sites to assess the existing conditions for implementing the reform in the 26 states and the Federal District; b) the application of a questionnaire, answered by 22 states, in order to find out how they were organizing themselves to provide continuing training for professionals; and c) a focus group with high school teachers from a state where the reform was well advanced in the education network. Difficulties were identified in the process of restructuring secondary education and challenges faced by teachers in the face of the changes, related to working conditions and continuing training, such as the reduction in teachers' workload, the lack of infrastructure and professionals to provide training itineraries and the impossibility of meeting students' training demands.

title: Formação em saúde na educação física Health education in physical education Formación en salud en educación física
abstract: The present study addresses the issue of health in the education of Basic Education students based on the analysis of a set of pedagogical experiences developed in Physical Education classes with High School classes. As an objective, we aim to discuss possibilities of pedagogical intervention taking the theme of health in school Physical Education. Methodologically, the study is characterized as an experience report developed with 1st grade high school classes at EA-UFPA, which collected information from the dynamics of teaching practice itself. We point out that the experience developed qualifies as an intervention that sought to systematize a set of knowledge, which, at this moment, we call “health knowledge in school Physical Education”. In this way, our results support the possibility of the pedagogical approach to health as an object of knowledge in Physical Education classes in a transformative perspective.

title: Impactos da incivilidade, technostress e justiça organizacional na saúde mental de professores de escolas públicas, moderados pelo suporte da gestão Impacts of incivility, technostress and organizational justice on the mental health of public-school teachers, moderated by management support Impactos de la incivilidad, la tecnostrés y la justicia organizativa em la salud mental de los profesores de escuelas públicas, moderados por el apoyo de la gestión
abstract: This research aimed to analyze the impacts of incivility, technostress and organizational justice on teachers' mental health, using a qualitative approach. Specifically, we also sought to analyze whether management support moderates the aforementioned relationships. The target population was Brazilian public elementary school educators and primary data collection was done through an online questionnaire. The results showed the negative impact of technostress on teachers' mental health, while the perception of organizational justice had a positive impact. However, incivility did not have a significant effect on teachers' mental health, nor did management support have a significant moderating influence on the proposed relationships. The need for research on the topic in Brazil and the relevance of this study for the educational field are highlighted, providing theoretical and practical insights that help school management and the development of effective policies to improve teachers' mental health, given their role crucial in society.

title: O trabalho e a evasão escolar em Humaitá/Amazônia e suas interfaces entre Tete/Moçambique Work and school dropout in Humaitá/Amazon and its interfaces between Tete/Mozambique Deserción laboral y escolar en Humaitá/Amazonía y sus interfaces entre Tete/Mozambique
abstract: The article "Work and school dropout in Humaitá/Amazon and its interfaces between Tete/Mozambique" investigates the relations between work and education, analyzing its implications for social and economic development in the contexts of the Brazilian Amazon, specifically in Humaitá in Amazonas and the province of Tete in Mozambique. The main objective is to understand how the capitalist mode of production perpetuates social inequalities, makes work more precarious and impacts education, especially in areas marked by mining. The research uses a bibliographic approach based on books, articles and dissertations, articulating historical analysis and local perspectives. In the first topic, the historical panorama of work and education in the Amazon is explored, highlighting the interconnection between these themes and the reflections of work practices on educational conditions. In the second topic, the challenges in Tete and Humaitá are analyzed, showing that mining, although important for the economy, aggravates environmental degradation and compromises the future of communities. The results show that both in Brazil and in Mozambique, education faces challenges such as school dropout an

title: Promoção de engajamento em um jogo educacional por meio da música Promoting engagement in an educational game through music Promover la inmersión en un juego educativo a través de la música
abstract: The use of digital games is currently considered one of the main ways to learn outside of school (De Wilde; Brysbaert; Eyckmans, 2020). However, for learning to happen, the game needs to promote engagement (Gee, 2007). According to Smith (2020), among the known resources to intensify the player's immersive experience, music occupies a relevant place. Several applied studies recognize that music has a direct influence on the gaming experience (Wharton; Collins, 2011; Zhang; Fu, 2015; Evans, 2018; Stingel-Voig, 2019; Grasso, 2020; Tasnim et al., 2024, among many others). However, these studies do not show how this influence occurs. This article presents a study that sought to understand how music can promote engagement in educational games. First, we bring theoretical support to correlate the use of music and engagement in digital games. Next, we present an educational game aimed at promoting English pronunciation designed for children aged 7 to 10 – the New Pac-English. Finally, we describe and analyze the distinctive role that music plays in this game. It was possible to verify that, in New Pac-English, the player needs to interact with the singing and the sounds of eight musical i

title: As Cartas Pedagógicas como possibilidade de lugar para a Educação Ambiental Pedagogical Letters as a space for Environmental Education Las Cartas Pegagógicas como posibilidad de lugar para la Educación Ambiental
abstract: The essay proposes a reflection intertwined with three main axes: Environmental Education, Pedagogical Letters, and the concept of Place. The discussion is a hermeneutic dialogue on the contribution of Pedagogical Letters to the construction of meanings of place for Environmental Education. The text is divided into: i) Opening words; ii) The meanings of place and placedness; iii) The relationship of places with Environmental Education; iv) Pedagogical Letters as a possibility for constructing a place for Environmental Education; v) Final considerations. It is a critical and reflective analysis of the world that surrounds and circumscribes us, aiming to envision what forms of existence to produce.

title: Conhecimentos sobre a docência nos anos iniciais em registros reflexivos Knowledge about teaching in the erly years in reflective records Conocimientos sobre la enseñanza en los primeros años en registros reflexivos
abstract: This article presents and discusses the construction of knowledge about teaching in the early years by student trainees on the Pedagogy course. The theoretical problematization is supported by studies in the field of teacher training and pedagogy. It starts from the premise that teaching develops when we recognize the existence of an in-between where theories and practices feed back into each other, favoring the teacher's specific knowledge. The research involved the interpretative analysis of reflective records drawn up by the trainees during their teaching internship in the early years. Based on the thematic analysis of the reflective records, four nuclei of meaning were identified: organization and functioning of the school; organization of pedagogical work - planning; insertion into teaching; the other of the pedagogical relationship. In each section, different aspects of teaching are discussed, such as situations of doubt, uncertainty, fear, affection, disaffection, failure, mediocrity, rupture and resistance. The strategies and knowledge developed by the trainees for action and understanding of the pedagogical act, a moment permeated with contradictions and tensions, are also

title: Autistando no Instagram Being autistic Autistando en Instagram
abstract: This essay aims to discuss posts made during the year 2024 on the Instagram profile of Carol Souza, a woman diagnosed with Autism Spectrum Disorder Level 2 of support. Autism is a unique condition that profoundly impacts the process of social interaction, communication skills, and the repertoire of interests and activities with the manifestation of behaviors marked by repetitive patterns. Due to her difficulty in communicating through speech, Carol actively works on the social network Instagram through her profile named Autistando, where she produces digital content, disseminates and discusses the complexity of autism and its impact on her own life. With clear and objective writing, the author presents explanations, examples and confrontations of actions based on prejudice, discrimination and ableism against people who experience autism in their lives, especially those who require greater support, support and acceptance. Finally, the text reveals the importance of virtual platforms for digital content as fertile virtual spaces and places for the social protagonism of people with disabilities, especially for those with greater difficulties in speaking and moving around in physical e

title: Referências formativas para a formação do professor avaliador no Brasil Formative references to teacher-evaluators education in Brazil Referencias formativas para la formación del profesor-avaliador en Brasil
abstract: Preservice Education has not been adequately preparing educators to use assessment effectively in improving student learning. Since teachers often have formative gaps, concerns about the education of an evaluating teacher have arisen due to the potential of the topic to improve teaching and learning. In the international context, the need for training programs based on the concept of "Assessment Literacy" has been emphasized. In Brazil, both past and recent research, despite acknowledging the central role of assessment in teacher education and the inadequate treatment of the topic in teacher training programs, has focused more on analyzing assessment practices, methodological aspects, and teachers’ and students’ conceptions, among other relevant issues. However, in this context, the preparation of an assessment-oriented teacher for basic education has not been a priority for researchers. Brazilian studies have rarely highlighted the identity, education, role, responsibilities, and theoretical framework necessary for the education of an assessment-oriented teacher. This article emphasizes the essential knowledge required for the education of such a professional. Given the absence of

title: Narrativas digitais de jovens no Tiktok Digital narratives of young people on Tiktok Narrativas digitales de jóvenes en Tiktok
abstract: This article focuses on students’ digital narratives about the Life Project curricular component, one of the main markers of the High School reform, which was the subject of Law 13.415/2017 and was recently updated by Law 14.495/2024. To this end, we used digital narratives as a way of capturing students’ experiences with the Life Project, based on student posts on the video-sharing network TikTok, one of the most popular and accessed online platforms in the contemporary world. The analysis of the material allows us to understand the vicissitudes of the reform for those who experience the policy in practice, since we consider that the audiovisual and written productions of young students are still a way of narrating the policy experienced in everyday school life. In conclusion, we consider that the void of meaning is represented by young people in audiovisual narratives that express boredom, sleepiness and boredom, recurring feelings that demonstrate the disconnection of a curricular component that does not engage with young people, by projecting a future that seems distant from factual reality.

title: Implicações das tecnologias digitais na cultura ocidental e seus desdobramentos no campo da saúde Implications of digital technologies in western culture and their impact on the health sector Implicaciones de las tecnologías digitales en la cultura occidental y su impacto en el sector salud
abstract: This article rehearsal addresses the implications of excessive consumption of digital technologies in contemporary Western society, aiming to understand how the use of technologies affects biological, cognitive, and social aspects, especially among young people. The text explores how intensive and prolonged use of digital platforms compromises concentration, logical reasoning, and memory, leading to health issues such as obesity, anxiety, and depression. Additionally, from the perspective of critical technology theory, it discusses the need for a balance between the use of technologies and offline activities, emphasizing the importance of critical debates to raise awareness among parents, educators, and policymakers about the potential harm to health and human development. The analysis suggests that, to mitigate these adverse effects, it is essential that the problem shifts from the private sphere to a state issue, aiming for regulation regarding the use of digital technologies.

title: As relações étnico-raciais nos livros didáticos de ciências da natureza Ethnic-racial relations in natural science textbooks Las relaciones étnico-raciales en los libros de texto de ciencias naturales:¿qué se ha discutido en tesis y disertaciones en los últimos años?
abstract: This work aimed to identify what has been discussed in recent years by researchers about black people and ethnic-racial issues in Natural Sciences Textbooks. Thus, 3 queries were made to the Brazilian Digital Library of Theses and Dissertations using terms related to the theme. For this review, the researches defended between 2013 and 2022 were selected, resulting in 2 theses and 8 dissertations. The results show that some changes have already occurred in the schoolbooks since the promulgation of Law 10639/03, however, they are still incipient. It was noted that carrying out content analysis is a methodological trend among the researches. Furthermore, it is noteworthy that this review can contribute to the identification of possible paths to be followed in future researches and the visibility of the field of studies.

title: Formação continuada de professores dos anos iniciais em matemática Inservice teacher education in early elementary mathematics Formación continua de profesores de los primeros años de la educación primaria en matemáticas
abstract: This article presents an excerpt of the final results of a research developed in the Master's in Education course which aimed to analyze national and international articles published in the years from 2018 to 2023 in the SciElo.org, Scopus and Web of Science databases with the theme of continued training of teachers in the early years of elementary school in mathematics, in order to identify how it has been approached and/or related to student learning. To this end, we conducted a bibliographical research - systematic review with a mixed approach and used Bardin's content analysis techniques. The final analysis reveals the need to invest in studies that relate the continued training of teachers in the initial years of elementary school in mathematics with student learning and/or practices applied in the classroom, thus expanding the focus beyond of teaching professional development.

title: Panorama da plataformização da educação no Brasil Overview on education platformization in Brazil Panorama de la plataformización de la educación en Brasil
abstract: This paper aims s to analyze studies on the platformization of education, aiming to identify the main challenges, opportunities, and risks associated with this phenomenon to extract recommendations for the ethical integration of digital technologies in education. The overview of the platformization of education is problematized using a qualitative methodology with an exploratory and descriptive character to give visibility to the selected studies to compose the state of knowledge for analysis. The investigation was carried out in three official national repositories: Oasisbr of IBCIT, Publications of Ipea, and Scielo Brazil. The results mainly show the precarization and intensification of teaching work, job insecurity, dependence on algorithmic evaluations, and concern about the lack of technological training for teachers. It is considered that, for the ethical and sustainable integration of digital technologies in education, the formulation of public policies is essential, to protect teachers' rights, ensure fair and decent working conditions, and guarantee school autonomy and the protection of educational data privacy is essential.

title: Parâmetros teóricos e diretrizes para a prática em educação digital Theoretical-conceptual parameters and guidelines for pedagogical practice in digital education Parámetros teóricos y directrices para la práctica en educación digital
abstract: Sanctioned in January 2023, Law No. 14,533 established the National Digital Education Policy (PNED), bringing new challenges to pedagogical practice in the school context. The "School Digital Education" axis integrates media education as a cross-curricular content in the formal curriculum of public schools in the country. This article proposes some theoretical-methodological guidelines that may guide media education practice in the school context, in accordance with the provisions of the policy. The research underlying this proposal reviewed and synthesized a significant number of theoretical and empirical studies developed in different countries over the past 20 years and produced and analyzed data on the perception of basic education teachers regarding the skills necessary for digital literacy. From this set of materials, theoretical parameters and guidelines for pedagogical practice were systematized.

title: Análise de imagens por meio do método documentário Analysis of images through the documentary method Análisis de imágenes mediante el método documental
abstract: The article offers an interpretation of a zine created by high school students based on the documentary method developed by Ralf Bohnsack. The zine was selected for analysis due to its focus on the presentation of bodies in these students' publications. The article provides an illustration of the adaptation of the Documentary Method in the analysis and interpretation of diverse visual data, while also expanding the scope of image analysis in the field of educational research. By reconstructing and applying the stages of the Documentary Method and these pictorial elements, it is possible to comprehend the entirety of the image through a simultaneous and non-sequential analysis, akin to that employed in a narrative or textual analysis.

title: Línguas de sinais em comunidades indígenas Sign languages in indigenous communities Lenguas de señas en comunidades indígenas
abstract: This study aims to analyze the emerging sign languages in Brazilian Indigenous communities, highlighting their importance for cultural identity and the challenges faced in their preservation. The research is based on a literature review, exploring theses and dissertations that investigate the emergence of these languages in various Indigenous communities, such as Kaingang, Guarani-Kaiowá, Terena, among others. The studies were selected from the Brazilian Digital Library of Theses and Dissertations (BDTD) and analyzed regarding preservation strategies, the challenges encountered, and the public policies necessary for their continuity. Emerging sign languages are essential for social inclusion and the cultural preservation of Indigenous communities. However, they face significant threats, such as the lack of institutional recognition and pressure to adopt established sign languages. The research concludes that it is necessary to promote public policies that value these languages and encourage preservation and revitalization initiatives, such as linguistic documentation and the training of bilingual educators. Further studies are urgently needed to ensure the continuity of these langu

title: A pesquisa e a extensão no programa universidade gratuita Research and extension in the programa universidade gratuita LA INVESTIGACIÓN Y LA EXTENSIÓN EN EL PROGRAMA UNIVERSIDADE GRATUITA
abstract: The article presents the results of a study on a higher education financing policy implemented by the state government of Santa Catarina in 2023, called the “Programa Universidade Gratuita” (PUG). The study aimed to analyze “whether” and “how” the regulatory frameworks of this policy altered the public financing regime for research and extension activities in higher education institutions in Santa Catarina. More specifically, the research sought to understand the importance and the role that research and extension occupy in the PUG. This is a qualitative, exploratory study, involving document collection and content analysis. The scope of the research includes Complementary Law No. 831, dated July 31, 2023, and Decree No. 219, dated August 2, 2023. The results indicate that the PUG is a policy for entry and permanence in higher education. However, unlike the previous Uniedu program, its implementation has not effectively involved research and extension as formative conditions. Thus, although the purpose of the Free University Program stems from a financial assistance policy aimed at facilitating access and permanence for young people in Santa Catarina, its focus has become largely c

title: BNCC e BNC-Formação BNCC and BNC-Formação BNCC y BNC-Formação
abstract: This article aims to analyze the effects of the BNCC and the BNC-Formação on teacher professionalization, because of educational reforms in Brazil since 2017. The research systematizes discussions held by Working Group 6 (WG 6) - Analytical Framework 4: BNCC and teacher training, linked to the project: "The BNCC in control of public education: neoliberal mechanisms to contain emancipatory educational perspectives", an action of the Diversity and Autonomy in Public Education Network (REDAP), made up of teachers and researchers from basic and higher education from various institutions in Brazil. The approach of this study is qualitative of a basic nature, using bibliographical research and documentary research as the main technical procedures for producing data. The analysis is based on the bias of historical and dialectical materialism, with teacher training as the phenomenon analyzed, based on the contradictions and mediations identified in the National Common Curriculum Base (BNCC) and the National Common Base for Basic Education Teacher Training (BNC-Formação). The analysis showed that the standardization of curricula and teacher training serves as instruments of control and supe

title: Em defesa da aprendizagem da avaliação na formação de professores In defense of assessment learning in teacher education En defensa del aprendizaje de la evaluación en la formación docente
abstract: This paper discusses the relevance of research in teacher education and assessment learning based on an activity developed with undergraduate students from a public institution of higher education in São Paulo, which consists of interviews with basic education teachers about their assessment conceptions and practices. The development process of this research activity is evidenced, indicating its relevance to the education of future teachers from a theoretical point of view and the students’ point of view. It is argued that teacher education courses should dedicate more time/space to address educational assessment in depth, contributing to the deconstruction of classificatory and exclusionary conceptions and practices and to the experience of alternative assessment processes, based on values and objectives that pursue a human, socially referenced education and with the potential to cause concrete changes in basic education classrooms.

title: Análise das vozes textuais sobre o desenvolvimento do pensamento computacional na educação básica Analysis of textual voices on the development of computational thinking in basic education Análisis de las voces textuales sobre el desarrollo del pensamiento computacional en la educación básica
abstract: The complementary guidelines for Computational Thinking (CT) in Basic Education lack reflections regarding their implementation, considering the need for continuous teacher training, curriculum updates for existing teacher education programs, and the creation of new undergraduate programs in Computer Science to meet this demand. Furthermore, it is necessary to investigate the methodologies, tools, and resources that support CT development, aiming to understand how different epistemologies can contribute to the comprehension of a topic that has not yet reached academic consensus regarding its dimensions. This article presents a State of Knowledge (SoK) literature review (Morosini et al., 2021) with the objective of investigating academic production on CT development in Basic Education. The study employs the Discursive Textual Analysis (DTA) methodology (Moraes & Galiazzi, 2016), seeking to understand the meanings attributed to the textual corpus and to organize the knowledge produced. The results highlight approaches based on Jean Piaget’s theory of thought genesis, Executive Functions, and Vygotsky’s historical-cultural perspective. Additionally, pedagogical alternatives are sugges

title: Impacto da pandemia por COVID-19 na educação e seus reflexos na construção do projeto político pedagógico da Escola de Frevo do Recife Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on education and its effects on the development of the educational political project of the Frevo School in Recife Impacto de la pandemia por COVIDF-19 en la educación y sus efectos en la construcción del proyecto político pedagógico de la Escuela de Frevo de Recife
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic had a profound impact on the country's social, political, and economic situation, significantly affecting formal and non-formal education institutions. In this context, the first Political Pedagogical Project (PPP) of the Maestro Fernando Borges Municipal Frevo School, known as the Recife Frevo School, was elaborated. Faced with the institution's historical demands and the new requirements resulting from the pandemic, the school's body faced the challenge of developing its PPP. Thus, this study aimed to investigate the impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic on the construction of the PPP of the Maestro Fernando Borges Municipal School of Frevo. Specifically, it aimed to identify the effects of the pandemic on the construction of the Recife Frevo School PPP. Data collection involved bibliographic research, documentary analysis of the school's history and reports of the PPP elaboration process. The pandemic imprinted its own dynamics on the discussions of the Recife Frevo School PPP, in addition to demanding adaptations that considered the new reality experienced. At the end of the work, the development of the PPP resulted in a document that met the objectives defined

title: Capital midiático Media capital Capital mediático
abstract: In recent decades, with the increase in public policies aimed at entering higher education, many students are the first in their families to be in this new environment. This article presents study tactics, in the sense of Certeau (1998), in confronting social and school inequalities that young people encounter in their trajectories. For two years, which also included the period of the Covid-19 pandemic, we followed thirteen young people from their final year of high school in the public school system in the Federal District, until the majority of them entered university. The discussion brings up cultural capital, but mainly its polysemic expansion in a digital society. Approaching Setton's (2005) conception, we work with media capital to understand the diffuse and hybrid learning of young people from the working class. In this symbolic struggle, they outline their tactics to operate in this foreign terrain, not made for them nor designed for their peripheral experiences. Despite using different technologies and having an infinite amount of information at their disposal, the importance of the teacher as a professional who humanizes relationships at school or university, who gives st

title: As práticas corporais da educação física escolar e o ensino remoto emergencial no município de Itapemirim/ES The body practices of school physical education and emergency remote teaching in the municipality of Itapemirim/ES Las prácticas corporales de educación física escolar y enseñanza remota de emergencia en el municipio de Itapemirim/ES.
abstract: During the Covid-19 pandemic, education underwent significant changes due to Ordinance No. 343/2020, which suspended in-person classes. Physical Education teachers faced challenges when adapting practical activities for remote teaching, using digital technologies. This exploratory research investigated how the teaching of bodily practices developed in Itapemirim/ES. Using a qualitative methodology, questionnaires and interviews were administered to teachers from 12 elementary schools. Content analysis revealed difficulties in adapting to the digital environment due to a lack of technological knowledge, resulting in a greater focus on theoretical content. Furthermore, students faced problems accessing equipment and technological resources, and difficulties understanding the activities. Despite the challenges, teachers recognized the potential of digital technologies for physical education, but highlighted the need for continued training, internet access and support from families to overcome difficulties.

title: Construindo trilhas de aprendizagem em inteligência artificial generativa Building learning trails in generative artificial intelligence Construyendo senderos de aprendizaje en inteligencia artificial generativa
abstract: This work aimed to investigate the contributions of a workshop on the use of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) in the creation of learning paths for higher education teachers. The workshop participants were master's and doctoral students from the Education, Technology and Communication (ETC) discipline of the Postgraduate Program in Education at the Catholic University of Brasilia in 2024. This article adopts a qualitative approach, with exploratory research from the perspective of complexity theory, which allowed the two axes of this study to be articulated: artificial intelligence and education. Considering that GenAI has significant potential to promote innovative teaching and learning practices and that its technological configurations are created by humans, it is concluded that the use of AI to create learning trails is a contributory tool to the extent that it suggests relevant activities, but it is important to highlight the need for training for teachers and managers in the appropriate use of AI in education and that issues relating to ethics, conscious, sustainable use, respect for diversity and equity are recognized as fundamental to the reliable use of AI in edu

title: Resenha crítica do livro Critical review of the book Entrar máquinas y formar gente
abstract: This critical review analyzes the book "Training Machines and Shaping People: Challenges of Educating in the Age of Artificial Intelligence," presenting it as strategic reading for the contemporary debate in Education. The book, authored by Brazilian and foreign researchers, addresses the challenges of human development and education in a time of accelerated technological innovations, such as Artificial Intelligence (AI). The topics covered in the book address issues starting from the emergence of Artificial Intelligence and human formation, through the lens of philosophical theorists, traverse the processes of democratic participation in a technocratic environment, and explore the challenges, possibilities, and limits of AI in educational contexts. The conclusion is the book is not merely a warning about the impacts of AI, but an invitation to critical pedagogical action, which is essential for Education to reaffirm its commitment to autonomy and reflection, in opposition to mere algorithmic obedience.

title: Educação do campo no Estado do Paraná Field education in the State of Paraná La educación del campo en el Estado de Paraná
abstract: This article analyzes field education in Brazil as an area that has been consolidating at each new achievement as a space of dialogue and articulation of education, challenge, and resistance experiences. However, due to the current political scenery, the occurrence of many attacks aiming its erasure and the return of practices aiming at rural education, with proposals of education actions of control, subjections, and acritical character has been observed. This study aimed to present the field education achievements related to the normative and pedagogical marks of these schools of/on islands of the state of Paraná coast. The methodological approach promoted a bibliographic and documental investigation, including discussion from the experience and practice of collective organization in the construction of education public policies for individuals of the field, waters, and forests. The results point out that the advances achieved in this historical moment are essential in the defense of field education (EdoC) against the state attacks.

title: Encontros entre cinema, cultura e jogo Encounters between cinema, culture and play Encuentros entre cine, cultura y juego
abstract: The text on screen explores a geophilosophical analysis of the film “Skater Girl”, inspired by Deleuze and Guattari, as a way of deterritorializing production in the field of art and territorializing it in the academic field. Reterritorialization allowed a broader analysis of the work, beyond its aesthetic interpretation, with an emphasis on its social, political and cultural implications. By territorializing the film in the field of Cultural Studies, we explore its cultural representations, identities and power dynamics. We highlight the relevance of the film as a cultural artifact, capable of providing insights into contemporary social issues, such as resistance and identity. Still based on the geophilosophical method, we adopted an approach based on studies on the Game, which allowed us to reinterpret skateboarding, a central practice in the narrative, as a tool of resistance against domination. By exploring the playful elements present in the work, we recognize the potential of skateboarding as a form of subversion and cultural strengthening capable of challenging existing social norms. title: A produção stricto sensu sobre fake news e deepfakes na educação Strict sensu production on fake news and deepfakes in education Estricta producción sensu sobre fake news y deepfakes en educación
abstract: This article aims to create a state of knowledge of stricto sensu production in the CAPES repository of theses and dissertations on the relationship between fake news and deepfakes and education. The section used to search for stricto sensu production will be research carried out in Postgraduate Programs in Education, from 2016 to 2023, whose general objectives are directly associated with the relationship between fake news and education. The methodological approach is qualitative. A bibliographic survey was carried out, state of knowledge based on Morosini (2015) and Morosini, Nascimento and Nez (2021), with searches carried out using combinations of the following descriptors: Fake news/False News, Deepfakes, Education and Disinformation, and the data were analyzed based on the construction of thematic categories proposed by the authors. In the results, seven studies were found - five master's theses and two doctoral theses -, with objects of study revolving around measures to combat misinformation, teaching strategies for addressing fake news and teaching authority in times of post-truth . title: Relações entre apatridia e infâncias Relations between statelessness and childhood Relaciones entre apatridia e infancias
abstract: Initiating with Albert Camus’ exploration of the absurd and revolt, this article delves into the implications of statelessness from birth. It highlights the intricate relationship between statelessness, childhood, and children based on International Conventions and Treaties and their connection to the Brazilian legal system. This exploratory study reflects on legislation and rights related to individuals in displacement contexts, such as migrants, refugees, and stateless persons. We examine their interactions with the concept of childhood and children, as well as their ways of inhabiting and transforming the world in light of current regulations. Additionally, we emphasize the challenges in the educational process, which, beyond the intentions and training of educators, requires attention to public policies that genuinely promote hospitality and integration with ethics and dignity in the face of the human condition, as advocated by constitutional principles. title: Correria, estresse, pausa no tempo Hustle, stress, pause on time Apuro, estrés, pausa del tiempo
abstract: This text discusses the appropriations and uses that nine teachers, six from Rio de Janeiro and three from Espírito Santo, made of what was portrayed in the K-dramas they watched. It situates the expansion of creation, circulation, and consumption of products from South Korea's cultural industry in the conducive context of cultural capitalism, South Korean government and private investments in culture, cyberculture, and the imagery it creates and enchants its users. It presents a segment of the data produced through research in/with educational networks' everyday life, employing the methodological procedure of conversation to address the teachers' creation of fables about time and the breaks they institute to slow down. It suggests, through thenarratives produced, that disrespect and devaluation in/with the school daily life are what drain them the most and points out practices and curricular processes they consider necessary for creating alternate realities for life insideout schools.

title: The role of additional language competence in the internationalization of Brazilian Graduate Programs according to CAPES’assessment documents El papel de la competencia en lenguas adicionales en la internacionalización de Programas de Posgrado en Brasil de acuerdo con los documentos de evaluación de la CAPES O papel da competência em línguas adicionais na internacionalização de Programas de Pós-Graduação do Brasil de acordo com os documentos de avaliação da CAPES
abstract: In Brazil, the Coordination for the Advancement of Higher Education Personnel (CAPES) is responsible for assessing the graduate programs in the country in terms of the education and research delivered, including their level of internationalization. Considering the internationalization process and competencies in additional languages as intertwined, this paper analyzes CAPES’ assessment documents regarding the role of additional languages in the internationalization of Brazilian graduate programs. The documents were coded, with the help of NVivo, according to a pre-designed coding system, and the different weights given to internationalization in the assessment were recorded. Differences were noted between the three broad disciplinary areas – Life Sciences; Humanities; and Exact, Technological, and Multidisciplinary Sciences – in the weight assigned to internationalization and the coding presence. The results show that activities specifically related to the teaching or learning additional languages or additional language proficiency are not priorities for the disciplinary areas. title: Dispositivo pedagógico smart Smart pedagogical device
abstract: The processes of smartification in educational practices are addressed, giving particular attention to the possibilities, challenges, and tensions that arise as we advance in understanding the smart pedagogical device. Existing records in digital repositories ERIC, IEEE Xplore, and Web of Science were examined, compiling a corpus of 224 articles subjected to the conditions provided by textual-discursive analysis. The findings suggest considering: 1. The relationship between smartification and customization of school/educational practices; 2. The dimensions involved in the objectification of the smart pedagogical device; and 3. The problematic axes, the tensional field, that emerges as the indicated pedagogical device is constituted.

title: Apresentação Presentation Presentación
abstract: O neoliberalismo, aliado ao neoconservadorismo, tem ganhado espaço em vários países do norte e do sul global, o que pode ser percebido na organização das chamadas reformas educacionais. Apple (2015) discorre sobre o fenômeno que tem sido vivenciado em várias nações, utilizando-se de exemplos ingleses, estadunidenses, neozelandeses e escandinavos, e aponta a importância de análises internacionais destas reformas, pois as desigualdades sociais que elas produzem já estão documentadas. A experiência destes locais pode revelar as problemáticas já experimentadas e denunciadas, servindo de horizonte para países como o Brasil, que tem investido em reformas educacionais na mesma direção já fracassada em outros lugares (Freitas, 2018). Dado o contexto brevemente apresentado, o Dossiê Desafios da educação escolar de pessoas com deficiência frente aos avanços do conservadorismo tem o objetivo de apresentar um conjunto de análises sobre a incidência do pensamento conservador e suas alianças com o neoliberalismo no campo do direito à educação de pessoas com deficiência, considerando a necessária articulação com outros marcadores sociais da diferença e a inter-relação com outros direitos sociais,
